cr_data.provenance: (An American Place, New York, NY); Albert Rothbert, New York, NY, 1934; The Topstone Fund, New York, NY, before 1970; Sotheby Parke Bernet, Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 3133, lot no. 40, 10 December 1970; The artist, 1970; (Doris Bry, New York, NY); Harold Diamond, New York, NY, 1976; Private collection, Woodbridge, Connecticut, 1977; Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, and Elaine Horwitch Gallery, Scottsdale, Arizona, 1978; Private collection, Sun Valley, Idaho, 1978; (James Corcoran, Los Angeles, California); Private collection, Grosse Point, Michigan, after 1978; Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 4628M, lot no. 91, 29 May 1981; (Parkerson Gallery, Houston, Texas); Private collection, Houston, Texas, 1981 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Sold to Mr. Rothbart." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Red Pepper, Green Grapes

description: A shiny, bright red pepper sits on a white plate amongst clusters of light green grapes. The background of the work is painted white.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
